title: Chat Architecture & Visibility Hotfixes
description: Hotfixes to improve the reliability of the new collaboration features, ensuring messages are saved correctly and the chat UI is fully accessible.

items.title: Chat Message Persistence
items.description: Refactored chat storage architecture to embed messages directly within dashboard documents.
details: **Embedded Architecture**: Moved from a separate `dashboard_message` table to an embedded `messages` array within the dashboard document. This simplifies data retrieval and eliminates synchronization issues.
**Thread Support**: Added underlying data structure support for threaded conversations (parent/child message relationships).
**Reliable Saving**: Fixed issues where messages appeared to save but wouldn't persist after refresh due to ID format mismatches.

items.title: Chat Visibility Fixes
items.description: Resolved critical layout issues preventing the chat sidebar from being fully usable.
details: **Sidebar Z-Index**: Increased z-index to ensure the chat sidebar always appears above other dashboard elements.
**Header Spacing**: Adjusted top positioning to prevent the chat header (and close button) from being hidden behind the main navigation bar.
**Transition Fixes**: Removed conflicting `v-if` directives to ensure smooth slide-in/slide-out animations.

items.title: User Identification
items.description: Improved how user data is displayed in chat.
details: **Safety Checks**: Added robust null checks for user emails to prevent "Cannot read properties of undefined" crashes.
**Data Fetching**: Fixed backend queries to ensure user details (name, avatar) are correctly fetched and displayed for every message.
